meta.model: Qwen3.8-27B (ATX and EXL3 arms) / Prism ML Ternary Bonsai 2 27B (PQ2_0 and PTQ1_0 arms)
meta.card: one RTX 3090 Ti, whole-card VRAM budget 23,552 MiB
meta.how_to_read: Every plotted number is a {value, source} cell. value = null means the measurement does not exist yet: make_figures.py draws that bar hatched and labels it 'pending'. Fill the value in and re-run the script unchanged. Nothing in this file is estimated, interpolated or rounded from a different condition than the one its label states.

conventions.MTP: decode with the model's own MTP head as the drafter, at the draft depth named in the label
conventions.2K check: a 2,048-token smoke generation, explicitly NOT a ship measurement; never plotted as one
conventions.full run: 20,480-token cap with a 5,000-generated-token floor, temperature 1.0, EOS honoured

fig03.title: What each format costs on disk
fig03.message: Bits per weight, and the file you actually download, for every format v0.3.1 serves.
fig03.footer:
File sizes are ls -l byte counts of the served GGUFs divided by 2^30. Every file carries the model's
native single-layer MTP head. The ternary files are Ternary Bonsai 2 27B; the other two are Qwen3.8-27B.
